fr_claquer_verb.hook: CLACK! Monsieur Verbe SLAMS the chest lid shut (klah-KAY).
fr_claquer_verb.why: The sound CLACK → claquer = to slam, to bang. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_affairer_verb.hook: Broom, bucket, frying pan – Monsieur Verbe is BUSY with all his AFFAIRS (ah-feh-RAY); the hand mirror says s'affairer.
fr_affairer_verb.why: Affairs, busy-ness → s'affairer = to bustle about. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_debarquer_verb.hook: BARK! BARK! As Monsieur Verbe steps off the boat, the little dog BARKS at him (day-BARK-ay).
fr_debarquer_verb.why: day-BARK-ay → débarquer = to get off a boat, to land, to disembark. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_atterrir_verb.hook: Bump! Monsieur Verbe floats down under his umbrella and LANDS right on his REAR (ah-tay-REER).
fr_atterrir_verb.why: a-tear-REAR: he lands on his rear → atterrir = to land, to touch down. Regular -ir: GREEN beret.

fr_absorber_verb.hook: Oops, sorbet on the ground! The mop soaks up the SORBET – ab-SORBET (ahp-sor-BAY).
fr_absorber_verb.why: ab-SORBET → absorber = to absorb, to soak up. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_tordre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe TWISTS the wet towel until it drips – TORsion (TORDR)!
fr_tordre_verb.why: Torsion, contort → tordre = to twist, to wring. Regular -re: PURPLE beret.

fr_inciter_verb.hook: 'Come on, in you go!' Monsieur Verbe ENCOURAGES the duckling – he INCITES it to swim (an-see-TAY).
fr_inciter_verb.why: Incite → inciter = to encourage, to prompt. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_basculer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BASKS in the sun… and his deck chair tips right over backwards (bahs-kew-LAY)!
fr_basculer_verb.why: BASK-ulay: basking, then tipping over → basculer = to tip over, to topple, to swing. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_boucher_verb.hook: The barrel springs a leak, so Monsieur Verbe stuffs a BUSH into the hole to plug it (boo-SHAY).
fr_boucher_verb.why: BUSH-ay → boucher = to plug, to block up, to cork. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_plier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe FOLDS the towel neatly, PLY on PLY (plee-YAY).
fr_plier_verb.why: Ply (layers) → plier = to fold, to bend. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_peupler_verb.hook: Look at all those PUPPIES! They POPULATE the whole pond (peuh-PLAY).
fr_peupler_verb.why: PUP-lay: puppies populating the pond → peupler = to populate, to fill with people. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_ruer_verb.hook: Like the pony, Monsieur Verbe KICKS his heels up behind him – the pony RUES the day you stand behind it (RWAY)!
fr_ruer_verb.why: ruer = to kick out (horses, donkeys). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_destiner_verb.hook: The gift is for the dog: its DESTINATION is the kennel – it is DESTINED for him (days-tee-NAY).
fr_destiner_verb.why: Destiny, destination → destiner = to intend for, to destine. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_replier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe FOLDS the map back up – RE-PLY, fold again (ruh-plee-YAY).
fr_replier_verb.why: Re + plier → replier = to fold up, to fold back. Used here with an object (no se): Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_pincer_verb.hook: Ow! The crab PINCHES his finger with its PINCERS (pan-SAY).
fr_pincer_verb.why: Pincers → pincer = to pinch. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_rattacher_verb.hook: Click! Monsieur Verbe clips the lead back onto his pet RAT – re-ATTACHing it (rah-tah-SHAY).
fr_rattacher_verb.why: RAT + attach → rattacher = to reattach, to tie back, to link. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_rejeter_verb.hook: 'No thank you!' Monsieur Verbe turns away and REJECTS the toy JET (ruhzh-TAY).
fr_rejeter_verb.why: re-JET-ay: rejecting the jet → rejeter = to reject, to throw back. Regular -er (je rejette): RED beret.

fr_crever_verb.hook: BANG! The bike wheel drops into a CREVICE and the tyre bursts (kruh-VAY).
fr_crever_verb.why: CREV-ice → crever = to burst, to puncture (a tyre). Regular -er (je crève): RED beret.

fr_repousser_verb.hook: The hay bale rolls at him and Monsieur Verbe PUSHES it BACK (ruh-pou-SAY).
fr_repousser_verb.why: Re + pousser (push) → repousser = to push back; also to postpone. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_enchainer_verb.hook: Loop after loop, Monsieur Verbe LINKS them into a CHAIN (ahn-shay-NAY).
fr_enchainer_verb.why: Chaîne = chain → enchaîner = to link up, to follow one after another. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_pieger_verb.hook: Gotcha! Monsieur Verbe TRAPS a giant PEA under his basket (pyay-ZHAY).
fr_pieger_verb.why: PEA-ay-zhay: trapping the pea → piéger = to trap. Regular -er (je piège): RED beret.

fr_abattre_verb.hook: Swing, BATTER! Monsieur Verbe swings the bat and KNOCKS DOWN the tee-ball stand (ah-BAHTR).
fr_abattre_verb.why: a BATTER knocking it down → abattre = to knock down, to cut down. Irregular (like battre): GOLD beret.

fr_faucher_verb.hook: Two FOES in a mowing race! Monsieur Verbe and his grumpy rival MOW the long grass head to head (foh-SHAY).
fr_faucher_verb.why: FOE-shay: two foes mowing → faucher = to mow, to scythe (and, casually, to swipe). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_hisser_verb.hook: Hissss! A friendly snake HISSES as it helps Monsieur Verbe HOIST the flag up the pole (ee-SAY).
fr_hisser_verb.why: HISS-ay → hisser = to hoist, to raise. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_enfoncer_verb.hook: Tap, tap – Monsieur Verbe DRIVES the tent peg IN with FORCE (ahn-fohn-SAY).
fr_enfoncer_verb.why: En + force → enfoncer = to drive in, to push in. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_craquer_verb.hook: CRACK! The dry stick CRACKS under Monsieur Verbe's foot (krah-KAY).
fr_craquer_verb.why: Crack → craquer = to crack, to creak. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_charrier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pulls a real little CHARIOT piled high with logs – he CARTS them along (shah-RYAY).
fr_charrier_verb.why: CHARIOT → charrier = to cart, to haul, to carry along. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il charrie du bois dans un petit chariot.
He carts wood in a little cart.

fr_projeter_verb.hook: Whoosh! Monsieur Verbe throws his paper JET far, far forward – PRO JET (proh-zhuh-TAY)!
fr_projeter_verb.why: PRO + JET: throwing a jet forward → projeter = to throw, to project (and to plan). Regular -er (je projette): RED beret.

fr_enterrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe BURIES the acorn IN the TERRA, the earth (ahn-tay-RAY).
fr_enterrer_verb.why: En + terre (earth) → enterrer = to bury. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_etendre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hangs out the washing and EXTENDS each shirt along the line (ay-TAHNDR).
fr_etendre_verb.why: Extend → étendre = to spread out, to hang out (washing). Used here with an object (no s'). Regular -re: PURPLE beret.
